meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel

howto.what: Claude 会把 iMessage 频道接入 NanoClaw:复制并注册适配器、安装依赖、构建并跑注册测试,再按你选的本地或 Photon 远程模式写配置、重启服务,最后解析你发消息用的手机号或 Apple ID。
howto.when: 当你提到「add imessage」「connect imessage」「add photon」等关键词,或要让 NanoClaw 接上 iMessage 时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude adds an iMessage channel to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, builds and runs the registration test, then writes local or Photon remote config, restarts the service, and resolves your handle.
howto.when_en: Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", or when you want NanoClaw to support iMessage.

say_en.note: It then asks whether to run local or remote
Remote mode; you paste your Photon server URL and API key
